import json, random, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp')
import ref

rng = random.Random(4)
# replicate generator quickly and find invalid cases
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fz", "tmp/fuzz.py")
fz = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(fz)

for it in range(60):
    doc = fz.gen_input(rng)
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', 'tmp/ref.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    out = json.loads(r.stdout)
    if out.get('error') == 'invalid':
        # find reason by revalidating stepwise
        try:
            ref.validate(doc)
            v = 'validate ok'
            ixps, rib, priors, declared, order_pairs, queries = ref.validate(doc)
            agg = {}
            for p, c in rib:
                q = ref.norm(p, ixps)
                if len(q) < 2 or len(set(q)) != len(q): continue
                t = tuple(q)
                agg[t] = agg.get(t, 0) + c
            final, rounds, links = ref.peel_ref(agg)
            core = sorted(k for k in links if k not in rounds)
            v += '; links=%d core=%d order=%s' % (len(links), len(core), order_pairs)
        except ref.Invalid:
            v = 'validate INVALID'
        print('iter', it, v)
        print(json.dumps(doc)[:500])
        break
EOF
